note: Northline Supply Co. apparel catalog. Categories consolidated to Hoodies/Tees/Accessories. Copy + featured flags consumed by setup-storefront. Order/analytics math is price-independent (line totals are plan-driven). Brands feed the product_brand taxonomy (Brand Loyal tag).

products.name: The Northline Hoodie
products.short_description: Our heavyweight everyday hoodie — 380gsm brushed-back fleece that softens with every wash.
products.description: The hoodie we built the whole line around. Dense 380gsm brushed-back fleece, a double-layer hood, and ribbing that keeps its shape after years of wear. Cut a touch longer in the body for grey mornings and long walks. Pre-shrunk, built to last, guaranteed.

products.name: Northline Hoodie — Logo
products.short_description: The Northline Hoodie with a small tonal chest mark. Same fleece, same fit.
products.description: Everything you like about the Northline Hoodie, finished with a small tonal North Line mark on the chest. 380gsm brushed-back fleece, double-layer hood, shape-keeping ribbing. Quiet branding for people who don't need a billboard.

products.name: Zip-Pocket Hoodie
products.short_description: A secured zip pocket on the classic fleece — for keys, cards and the trailhead.
products.description: The everyday hoodie with a hidden zip pocket set into the front pouch, big enough for a phone and secure enough to trust on the trail. Same 380gsm fleece and long-body cut. The one you grab when your hands are full.

products.name: Full-Zip Hoodie
products.short_description: A full-zip layer in the same heavyweight fleece — easy on, easy off, all season.
products.description: A full-length YKK zip turns the Northline fleece into your go-to mid-layer. Throw it over a tee on cool mornings, shed it by noon. Reinforced zip garage, dense 380gsm fleece, and the same long, keep-its-shape cut as the pullover.

products.name: Everyday Tee
products.short_description: A 220gsm cotton tee with structure — holds its shape wash after wash.
products.description: Not a throwaway tee. Mid-weight 220gsm combed cotton with a clean set-in collar that won't stretch out, side-seamed so it hangs straight. The white tee you stop replacing because this one keeps going.

products.name: Everyday Tee — Logo
products.short_description: The Everyday Tee with a small North Line mark. 220gsm, keeps its shape.
products.description: Our mid-weight 220gsm cotton tee with a small tonal North Line mark at the chest. Structured collar, straight hang, side-seamed construction. Understated branding on a tee that lasts.

products.name: V-Neck Tee
products.short_description: A clean V-neck in the same structured 220gsm cotton.
products.description: The Everyday Tee in a tailored V-neck. Mid-weight 220gsm combed cotton, a V that sits right — not too deep — and a shape that survives the laundry. Layers under a shirt or stands on its own.

products.name: Long-Sleeve Tee
products.short_description: The shoulder-season staple — 240gsm cotton with rib cuffs.
products.description: For the weeks between tee and hoodie. A slightly heavier 240gsm cotton long-sleeve with ribbed cuffs that stay put and a clean crew neck. Wears solo now, layers later.

products.name: Pique Polo
products.short_description: A structured cotton-pique polo that dresses up or down.
products.description: A polo with a bit of backbone. Breathable cotton pique, a collar with enough structure to stand on its own, and a trim-but-not-tight cut. Works over the weekend and holds up at the desk.

products.name: Watch Cap Beanie
products.short_description: A double-layer rib-knit watch cap for real cold.
products.description: A proper watch cap. Double-layer rib knit in a soft acrylic-wool blend, snug without squeezing, with a fold that sits right above the ears. The one that lives in your coat pocket all winter.

products.name: Watch Cap — Logo
products.short_description: The double-layer beanie with a woven North Line label.
products.description: Our rib-knit watch cap finished with a small woven North Line label on the fold. Double-layer for warmth, acrylic-wool blend for softness, and a fit that stays put in the wind.

products.name: Field Cap
products.short_description: A six-panel cotton cap with a pre-curved brim and metal buckle.
products.description: A cap that breaks in, not down. Washed cotton twill, a six-panel crown with a pre-curved brim, and an adjustable antique-metal buckle at the back. Structured enough to look sharp, soft enough to pack.

products.name: Leather Belt
products.short_description: Full-grain leather with a solid antique-brass buckle.
products.description: A belt you'll re-buckle for a decade. Full-grain vegetable-tanned leather that patinas as it ages, stitched edges, and a solid antique-brass buckle. Cut wide enough for jeans, clean enough for chinos.

products.name: Field Sunglasses
products.short_description: Polarized lenses in a lightweight acetate frame.
products.description: Glare-cutting polarized lenses in a lightweight keyhole acetate frame with spring hinges that take a knock. UV400 protection, a slim profile that suits most faces, and a hard case to keep them trail-ready.
